Class SdCard

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io.SdCard
public final class SdCard extends Object
Access to an SPI SD card, backed by the Arduino SdFat library with long-file-name support enabled.

Call begin() for the standard D10 chip-select pin, or begin(int) for custom wiring, before opening or writing files. Every path must currently be a compile-time string literal and use the SD card's root as its base. open(String) is read-only; the three writers, appendLine(String, String) (adds a line) and appendText(String, String) (adds raw text), each open the file, write, and close it again rather than keeping a writable handle open. To replace a file, remove(String) it first.

Limits:

  • Paths are compile-time string literals, so their length is not limited by the runtime.
  • A literal line passed to appendLine(String, String) has no length limit either, but a line built while the program runs (String.valueOf, concatenation, StringBuilder.toString()) lives in a runtime-string slot of RuntimeLimits.STRING_SLOT_CAPACITY_BYTES bytes including the NUL terminator: 31 characters at most, and a longer value panics rather than truncating. Split longer records over several calls; each call ends its line with a newline.

Hardware: any SPI SD socket wired to the board's SPI pins and a chip-select pin works, for example the SD socket of the ELEGOO 2.8" TFT touch shield (see TftTouchShield) or a data logger module such as the AZ-Delivery one, which pairs the card with a real-time clock. Pass its chip-select pin to begin(int) when it is not D10.

See Also:
  • AZ-Delivery data logger module
  • ELEGOO 2.8 inch TFT touch screen with SD card socket

    • size

      public static int size(String path)
      Returns the size of path in bytes, or -1 when it does not exist or cannot be opened. A file over Integer.MAX_VALUE bytes reports Integer.MAX_VALUE. Use it to tell whether a log has grown too large or a file is empty; InputStream.available() only says whether bytes remain.

    • open

      public static InputStream open(String path)
      Opens path for reading, or returns null when it cannot be opened.

    • appendLine

      public static boolean appendLine(String path, String line)
      Appends line plus a newline to path, creating the file first if it does not exist yet. Unlike open(), line may be a runtime string. Returns whether the write succeeded.

    • appendText

      public static boolean appendText(String path, String text)
      Appends text to path exactly as given, creating the file first if it does not exist yet: unlike appendLine(String, String) no newline is added, so a record can be written in pieces (each piece within the runtime-string limit above) or be raw text such as CSV fields. Returns whether the write succeeded.

    • remove

      public static boolean remove(String path)
      Deletes path from the card. Returns whether it was removed.
